column2: すまない|済まない|すまなかった|済まなかった|ねばならない
column3: REG-12: the set apology and the maxim keep their -다
REG-12: a guess that is the casual 겠지 in a casual quote
REG-3: a plain end of musing in a lady's polite quote stays plain
REG-25: endings kept at 합쇼체: the 해요체 form of 답니다 (대요, 래요) reads as hearsay (거랍니다 is no 거래요); 습니다요 renders the ますです tic

column2: 皆さん|みなさん|皆様|皆さま|おふたり|お二人|あなた|貴方|貴殿|貴公
column3: REG-26: a quote addressing the audience or the distant あなた (당신) keeps its levels wherever the term stands: it names the listener; each term is matched as a word

column2: マスター|師匠|陛下|閣下|殿下|王様
column3: REG-38: a master, a lord or royalty, who can also be spoken of: only a call keeps the levels, the term before a mark that ends the call (師匠、, 分かりました、師匠), not a mention (師匠の家に, 王様は)
REG-26: the customer of service speech: holds the quote wherever it stands (お客様は何名様ですか)
REG-26: kana after an address term that make it the stem of a verb (マスターした)
REG-26: a title right after a name used as a call, before 、！？… or the quote's end (ロウリア王、, 穂積殿。): not 魔王は, 王国, 神殿に
REG-27: verbs of state, feeling or cognition: their present 합쇼체 statement states no will and is lowered (모릅니다 → 몰라요, 됩니다 → 돼요, 믿습니다 → 믿어요, 생각이 듭니다 → 들어요)
REG-27: the end of a lemma that makes it a passive or a change the subject does not do (정해지다, 만들어지다): lowered

column2: 届き|起こり|沸騰し|間に合い
column3: REG-27: source verbs (before ます) of an event its subject does not do, outside the -aru pairs of lower.event-okuri (届きます 닿아요)
REG-27: the kana of an -aru intransitive after its kanji before ます (始まります, 変わります, 助かります, 上がります): an event, lowered

column2: 泊まり|加わり|預かり|掴まり|捕まり|当たり|頑張り
column3: REG-27: verbs of that shape the speaker does do (泊まります, 預かります): they keep the hold
REG-27: the connective of an obligation (본받아야 합니다 → 해야 해요): the 하다 after it states no will

column2: 我等|我ら|我々|われら|われわれ|うちら|あたしら|自分ら|自分
column3: REG-27: a first person (plural) the first-person cues miss, and 自分 said of oneself: its が is the speaker's (我等が証言します 우리들이 증언합니다, 自分がやります)

column2: ではありませんか|じゃありませんか|ではないですか|じゃないですか|ではないのですか|じゃないんですか|ではないんですか
column3: REG-37: a negative copula that asserts more than it asks (仲間ではありませんか 동료가 아닙니까): no ? and its 합쇼체 is kept

column2: さん|くん|ちゃん|さま|たち|あいつ|こいつ|そいつ|どいつ|みんな|みな|やつ
column3: REG-27: kana ends of a noun before が that make it another subject (田中さんが, あいつが, みんなが)
